name: Garni Nadine
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in Soelden, Garni Nadine offers genuine alpine warmth for mountain lovers. Welcoming rooms and a generous breakfast set the perfect tone for an eventful holiday in the Oetztal valley.

The base stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable cars, along with the village center, are easily accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Garni Nadine in Soelden features cosy guestrooms and a great location for winter and summer sports in Oetztal.
